injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.detail: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Duncan Robinson
injuries.detail: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.detail: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Taurean Prince
injuries.detail: Prince (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Ronald Holland II
injuries.detail: Holland is out for Tuesday's game against San Antonio due to a left knee contusion.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.detail: Joe (hip) is out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.detail: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.detail: Niederhauser (foot) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Jazz.

injuries.name: Austin Reaves
injuries.detail: Reaves (heel) is out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Walker Kessler
injuries.detail: Walker (leg) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Jonathan Kuminga
injuries.detail: Kuminga (shoulder) is out for Tuesday's game against Portland.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jaylen Clark
injuries.detail: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

injuries.name: Zyon Pullin
injuries.detail: Pullin (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Portland.

injuries.name: Deni Avdija
injuries.detail: Avdija (foot) is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Timberwolves.

injuries.name: Ja Morant

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.detail: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game at Minnesota.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Scottie Barnes
injuries.detail: Barnes (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.detail: Leonard (knee) has progressed in his strength and conditioning program but will miss at least one more week, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
injuries.detail: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

injuries.name: Jaxson Hayes
injuries.detail: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Clippers.
